This Writ Petition is filed under Articles 226 and 227 of
the Constitution of India, praying to call for the records on the
file of the respondents peruse the same allow the writ petition,
quash the notice dated 13.11.2017 vide Annexure-A issued by
respondent No.2, and etc.

This Petition coming on for Preliminary Hearing this day,
the Court made the following:-
 Order

Heard Sri.H.M.Muralidhar, learned counsel appearing for petitioner and perused the records.
2. Petitioner is said to be carrying on hotel business under name and style "Swadesh Fine and Dine Restaurant"
at 4th 'T' Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru.

It is contended that after obtaining trade license and the license as required under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006,
said business is being carried on without violating any of the conditions imposed under these licenses and in this factual background, impugned notice dated 13.11.2017 has now been issued by 2nd respondent to show cause as to why license should not be cancelled.

It is further contended that despite petitioner having replied to the said notice on 20.11.2017 - Annexure-D, respondents are not allowing the petitioner to carry on the business peacefully and are visiting the business premises quite often and threatening the petitioner that business would be closed down.

3. A perusal of impugned notice would disclose that on the basis of the complaint received by 2nd respondent from neighbours of the petitioner's establishment, impugned notice has been which has been duly replied by the petitioner on 20.11.2017 - Annexure-D.
Thus, it would be incumbent upon the authorities to adjudicate the said notice in accordance with law.

4. As such, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this petition stands disposed of by observing that respondent - authorities would be required to consider the reply filed by petitioner to show cause notice - Annexure-A and pass orders thereon.

Since allegation of petitioner that officials of 2nd respondent office are visiting the business premises is only a self serving statement and not supported by any complaint lodged by petitioner to higher authorities in that regard, same cannot be entertained.
Ordered accordingly.

SD/-
